dict.string: Saku reads the current song from Spotify, Music or your browser and plays, pauses or skips it when you press its buttons.
Saku shows today's events and counts down to your next meeting in the notch.
Saku shows your reminders in the notch so you can tick them off.
Saku shows a live mirror in the notch. The video never leaves your Mac and is never saved.
The teleprompter listens to your voice to scroll the script as you speak. Audio stays on your Mac.
The teleprompter recognises your speech on this Mac to follow along with the script.
